title: The continuous stream of feeling anchors the self

statements.text: The continuous stream of interoceptive feelings reflects the current state of the body and is the basis for an uninterrupted sense of self and of ownership of the body. Exteroception is episodic and describes the world, not the self, and cognition and language build on bodily unity rather than anchor it.
